First let me explain how sensors work in Encore Framework:
The sensors detect collisions using the raycast conditions of GDevelop, they need to be skipped if their collision is disabled and they should check for collision with the main floor, layer 0 and layer 1.
So if the sensor code was copied for every single sensor, that would be a mess.
Instead I store the data that describes sensors inside of SensorsData array and then keep the shared sensor code in one place that iterates over the array.
Neat, right? :D
The sensors do not rotate all the time when the player's angle changes, they kind of have a rotation snap of 90 degrees to be accurate to Sonic games
Ground sensors are used to stick the player to the floor and check if the player is still on the ground
We use the same sensors for both the floor and the ceiling depending on the player's Y speed
Since each sensor occupies 6 array entries for its data we divide the array element count by 6
Determine if the sensors are horizontal or not
